answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM-rooted SGX enclave, binding its measured code and hardware key into the juniper state tree; marble is the epoch hash anchor, and saffron is the consensus contract. To forge N identities, an adversary must provision N physically distinct attested devices and extract each enclave key, while saffron enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversibly slashes invalid collateral.
